Name: Sebastian's Bong Restored
Author: lakoria
Description:
[font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=1][center]When you marry Sebastian, he brings a blue vase with him to decorate his special room in your home. This vase used to be a bong. I turned it back into a bong because hey, some people are cool with their pixelated husband getting high. Please see images for a comparison.[/center][/size][/font]

[b]INSTALLATION:[/b]
1. Extract townInterior.xnb to your Stardew Valley\Content\ directory, allow file to be overwritten. If this method doesn't work, extract to your Stardew Valley\Content\Maps directory.
2. Play! 

This mod is NOT compatible with any other mods that edit townInterior.xnb. If you already have a mod editing townInterior.xnb and would also like to use the bong, feel free to combine them or ask me for help.
